item.title: Popular Cape Town watersports site becomes a toxic health hazard
item.description: Zeekoevlei is used by schools and clubs for sailing and rowing but a toxic algal bloom has led to it being closed since December. Continuous pollution from the Big Lotus River, combined with hot weather, has caused a bloom of cyanobacteria (commonly called blue-green algae) in Zeekoevlei.
